title: Date picker picks
brand: DATEPICK-1 Shared date picker: pick per screen
intro: Today every date field is the browser's own input. Each step shows today (before) and 3 designs (after) for one screen on one device. Every option keeps all 10 field behaviours; the stored value format does not change.
beforeAfter: before = ui-forms 1.41.0 native input, same form and fixture

steps.target: [data-target] (the picker; before: the native date input)
steps.title: Date field on a phone
steps.question: Which date picker on a phone?

options.name: Popover under the field
options.why: Type day, month and year in place, or pick in a calendar that opens under the hint. Clear and Today in the footer.

options.name: Month and year menus
options.why: A bottom sheet with month and year menus for far dates, large day cells and Set date to confirm.

options.name: Quick picks over the grid
options.why: Typed as DD / MM / YYYY. Four quick picks (today, +1 day, +1 week, month end) sit above the calendar.

steps.title: Date range on a phone
steps.question: Which range picker on a phone?

options.name: Presets first
options.why: One field. A sheet with the range and Apply on top, preset chips, then one month.

options.name: Months first
options.why: One field. Presets in a menu; the months scroll down in one list, the next month peeks below.

steps.title: Date range on a computer
steps.question: Which range picker on a computer?

options.name: Presets first
options.why: One field. Presets in a rail beside two months; the range, Cancel and Apply in the footer.

options.name: Months first
options.why: One field. Preset chips above two months; the range, Cancel and Apply in the footer.

options.name: Linked From and To fields
options.why: Two fields, as today, sharing one two-month calendar; presets and Apply in the footer.

steps.target: n/a -- the motion previews are drawn SVG, no DOM to aim at
steps.title: Motion: open and month change
steps.question: Which motion for opening the calendar and changing month?

options.name: Grow from the field
options.why: Opens with a small scale and fade in 180 ms; months slide 16 px in 200 ms. Shows where the calendar came from.

options.name: Fade only
options.why: Opens and changes month with a 140 ms fade, no movement. The calmest; suits dense forms.

options.name: Drop and slide
options.why: Drops 8 px with a fade in 160 ms; the month slides a full width in 200 ms, the way the arrow points.
